{{Quote|Intruders detected! Initiating counter measure 428.75|Boss miner droid|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''</ref>}}
The '''Boss miner droid''', also called the '''Super miner droid''' was a [[mining droid]] that had a dangerous weapon on its back. It helped the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] dig up [[Force crystal]]s on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The super miner droid noticed [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and attempted to attack the two [[Droid/Legends|droids]], but Artoo closed the door in time to save them.
